title: Publishing Kali learning app to Expo and the live admin download panel
summary: Preparing a production-channel Android 1.0.5/build 7 release and compatible Expo update, then updating the live admin APK link.

changes.detail: User authorized publishing the updated learning app to Expo and the live admin panel. Preparing an EAS release build to include production update-channel metadata missing from the earlier local APK.

Release debug-code audit now parses executable syntax instead of mistaking JavaScript lesson strings for runtime logging. Added checks for actual log/debugger statements and template expressions. No lesson code or historical reports removed.

validation.name: Source secret audit
validation.detail: 1160 application/content files checked without findings; secret values were not logged.

validation.name: Initial release tests
validation.detail: Four tests passed; configuration test falsely flagged console.log inside a lesson example string. Syntax-aware correction awaits verification.

validation.name: Publication
validation.detail: New Expo build/update and live admin environment change are pending. Prior live deployment recorded for rollback. Native 1.0.4 devices require installation of the 1.0.5 APK; no physical device test or Wi-Fi activation.
